title: Apple engineer apologizes for creating autocorrect feature on iPhone
text:
Apple engineer apologizes for creating autocorrect feature on iPhone
The man who invented the iPhone's autocorrect feature knows you hate it - and he's sorry. From innocent mistakes to repeatedly needing to correct the word 'ducking', iPhone's autocorrect fails have become so prevalent they've inspired an entire website. That's why Ken Kocienda, a former Apple software developer who invented the iPhone touchscreen keyboard as well as the autocorrect feature, is apologizing. Kocienda took to WIRED for an op-ed on the feature, saying he was proud that he was able to bring 'software-assisted typing' to smartphones.
